title: Harness
description: Frontmatter of one harness in the beta corpus, corpora/beta/harnesses/<id>.md. The id is the filename, so it is not repeated here.

name.description: Display name, as the vendor writes it.

vendor.description: The company or organization that makes it.

docs.description: The start of its user documentation.

repository.description: The public source repository; omitted when the source is not public.

license.description: SPDX license id; omitted when it is not open source.

open_source.description: Whether its source is published under an open-source license.

cli.description: The command a user types to start it; omitted when it has no CLI.

surfaces.description: Where it runs: terminal, editor, desktop app or browser.

status.description: Whether the vendor still develops it.

successor.description: The harness id the vendor names as its replacement.

fork_of.description: The harness id it was forked from.

checked.description: The date this entry was last checked against its sources.

sources.description: The pages every value above comes from.

id.description: A harness id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

source.description: A page that backs one or more field values: a vendor site, docs, repository or release list.
